name: v2-arcs-radius-rejected
expected_serial_contains: Error: Radius mode not supported by G2 or G3
review: At the named firmware revision, Robot.cpp reports an error for G2/G3 with an R argument before process_move; Dispatcher.cpp reports the error, broadcasts halt and rejects subsequent G-code while halted. The initial X0 Y0 move requires no steps, so the expected empty trace and both required serial messages follow independently from the source and input. This checks rejection and halt in simulation, not radius-arc motion or physical hardware.
